entry.title: My default apps of 2025
entry.author: vinh
entry.preview: It's nice to keep track how I use technologies as time goes by.
entry.content:
From going-flying.com I discovered an interesting topic on tracking the default app that I used for a specific purpose. Let's see how it will look like as time goes by.

  • Calendar: Apple Calendar.
  • Cloud storage: iCloud.
  • Code editor: IntelliJ, vim.
  • Contacts: Apple Contacts with CardDAV.
  • Mail client: Yahoo! Webmail, Apple Mail.
  • Mail service: Yahoo!, Outlook.
  • Messages: iMessages.
  • Notes: Apple Notes.
  • Password manager: KeePass.
  • Photo editing: Capture One.
  • Photo library: Apple Photos.
  • RSS client: NetNewsWire.
  • Screenshots: macOS built-in tool.
  • Search: Kagi.
  • Terminal: kitty.
  • Web browser: Chrome, Firefox, Safari.
